scripts.lint: biome check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json commitlint.config.mjs .release-please-manifest.json release-please-config.json scripts .github && turbo run lint
scripts.precommit:check: pnpm lifecycle:test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check-types && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm package:check && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm release:check && pnpm docs:check
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile cli --profile test build cli test
scripts.docker:cli: docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile cli run --build --rm cli
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile test run --build --rm test
scripts.docker:lint: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile hooks run --build --rm lint-staged
scripts.docker:commitlint: docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile hooks run --build --rm commitlint pnpm exec commitlint --edit
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose -p portcn-dev -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile cli --profile test --profile hooks down --rmi local --volumes --remove-orphans
